text:
Sasha: Quick sync — need decision on transport for internal inference-routing API. Requirements: sub-10ms p99 for internal calls, browser fallback for hosted UI, strict per-tenant quotas, rich telemetry (trace + token counts). Thoughts?

Maya: My 2c: gRPC unary/streaming for service-to-service. Good latency and streaming for KV/cache pipelining.

Jordi: Agree for internal. But hosting the console or third-party integrators need REST+JSON. Gateway can transcode.

Ken: Concern: protobufs binary + Envoy transcoder causes header losses and harder debugging. Also CORS for browser.

Sasha: Right — tradeoffs. Two patterns: (A) Gateway/proxy transcode: clients use REST, gateway -> gRPC to backends. (B) Sidecar per-service -> backends expose gRPC only; edge gateway routes raw gRPC-web or JSON.

Maya: (A) simpler ops, single canonical surface at gateway. But adds CPU cost at gateway under high QPS.

Jordi: (B) has more moving parts but keeps gateway lightweight; sidecar can handle auth/quota locally and emit telemetry.

Ken: For quotas we need token-level breakdown in console. That implies quota enforcement point must emit granular counters. Sidecar gives per-service/finer counts.

infra-bot: Deploy bot: can schedule a canary once RFC approved :robot_face: 

Sasha: Proto snippet for the route API:
```proto
service Router {
  rpc Route(Request) returns (Response) {}
  rpc StreamRoute(stream Request) returns (stream Response) {}
}
message Request { string tenant = 1; bytes payload = 2; }
```

Maya: Also think about streaming for kv-cache warmup; gRPC streaming reduces RTTs.

Jordi: What about health checks & retries? Gateway has better consolidated retry policy; sidecars need consistent policy.

Maya: We can centralize policy via control plane configs and push to sidecars.

Ken: Observability: need consistent trace IDs propagated across gateway/sidecar. Use x-trace headers and map in Envoy.

Sasha: UX: Console team needs a consistent telemetry schema: route, model, tenant, tokens, latency_ms, error_code. We'll need a migration plan.

Maya: Implementation path: start with gateway-transcode proof-of-concept for a few routes, measure CPU and added p99. If OK, keep gateway-first; if not, iterate to sidecars.

Jordi: +1 canary plan: route 5% of traffic through sidecar path; collect per-tenant quota correctness and token counts for 24h.

Ken: Also add a debug-mode that returns proto-as-json payloads for easier debugging in dev.

Sasha: Action items: Maya to spike gateway-transcode POC (2w), Jordi to draft canary plan, Ken to mock telemetry schema. We'll sync next Tue.

Maya: ack :thumbsup:

Jordi: ack

Ken: ack

Sasha: Thanks all.
